players.bio: Adri Mehmeti (born April 6, 2009) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. He has represented Albania and the United States at youth level.
Aidan Stokes (born January 14, 2008) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls and MLS Next Pro side New York Red Bulls II.
Anthony "AJ" Marcucci Jr. (born August 31, 1999) is an American soccer player who currently plays as a goalkeeper for MLS side New York Red Bulls.

Andy Emanuel Rojas Maroto (born 5 December 2005), also known as Tuti, is a Costa Rican professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or forward for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls and the Costa Rica national team.

Cade Dylan Cowell (born October 14, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a striker or winger for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls, on loan from Liga MX club Guadalajara, and the United States national team.
Cameron Harper (born November 19, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer side New York Red Bulls.

David Antonio Ruiz Ochoa (born 8 February 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami. Born in the United States, he represents the Honduras national team. Born in Miami, Ruiz later moved to Honduras at age five, before moving back to the United States three years later. Ruiz played youth soccer with the Miami United Stars for seven years.
Dennis Gjengaar (born 24 February 2004) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.
Devin Padelford (born January 3, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer MLS club Minnesota United.
Dylan Nealis (born July 30, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.

Emil Peter Forsberg (Swedish pronunciation: ; born 23 October 1991) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls and the Sweden national team. Forsberg was awarded Guldbollen in 2021 as Sweden's best footballer of the year. He has also been voted the Swedish Midfielder of the Year four times (2016, 2017, 2019 and 2021).

Jean-Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (born 23 March 1989) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Born in Germany, he plays for the Cameroon national team. Choupo-Moting began his career with Hamburger SV, making his Bundesliga debut in August 2007. He spent the 2009–10 season on loan at 1. FC Nürnberg and in August 2011 he joined 1.
Ethan Shea Horvath (born June 9, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls, and the United States national team.

Karl Gustav Vilhelm Berggren (born 7 September 1997) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Berggren made his debut for the Sweden national team on 9 January 2020 in a friendly game against Moldova.

Jahkeele Stanford Jack Marshall-Rutty (born 16 June 2004) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls and the Canada national team. Club career Early career Marshall-Rutty began playing youth soccer with Brampton East SC when he was seven. He later moved to the Rush Canada Academy.
John Joseph McCarthy III (born July 4, 1992) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.

Jorge Antonio Ruvalcaba Castro (born 23 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Born in the United States, he represents the Mexico national team. Club career Born in Rialto, California, Ruvalcaba began his career with FC Golden State Development Academy.

Juan José Mina González (born 27 July 2004) is a 21-year-old Colombian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for the Major League Soccer (MLS) club New York Red Bulls. He is the younger brother of veteran Colombia international center-back Yerry Mina.
Julián Andrés Bazán Medina (born 25 November 2005) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a defender for New York Red Bulls.
Julian Zakrzewski Hall (born March 24, 2008) is an American soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.
Justin Isiah Che (born November 18, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back and center-back for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.

Matthew Dos Santos (born June 5, 2008) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Club career Early career Born in Sandy Hook, Connecticut, Dos Santos began his time in New York in 2017, playing for the New York Red Bulls Pre-Academy team, later moving up the ranks into the U-12 Academy group.

Michael Sheehan Bradley (born July 31, 1987) is an American former professional soccer player who is currently the head coach of the New York Red Bulls in Major League Soccer. The son of soccer coach Bob Bradley, Michael began his professional career in Major League Soccer with the MetroStars in 2004.
Mohammed Sofo (born 31 October 2004) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays as a forward for New York Red Bulls.
Omar Javier Valencia Arauz (born 8 June 2004) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls and the Panama national team.

Rafael Antonio Mosquera Díaz (born 25 May 2005) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for MLS Next Pro club New York Red Bulls II and Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Career C.D. Plaza Amador Born in Panama, Mosquera began his career with Panamanian club C.D. Plaza Amador.
Roald Mitchell (born January 13, 2003) is an American soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.

Robert Voloder (born 9 May 2001) is a German professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls. Club career In May 2020, Voloder signed his first professional contract with 1. FC Köln that would keep him at the club until 2023. In June 2021, he was sent on loan to Slovenian PrvaLiga side Maribor.
Ronald Donkor (born 20 November 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.
Timothy Ryan Parker (born February 23, 1993) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club New York Red Bulls.
